description: Per-lesson dominant visual style orchestration for KML image/study generation. Derived from kanji_image_production.csv semantic analysis; aligned with lesson_assignments_v2.json families. One dominant style per lesson; 1–2 intentional accent kanji only.
design_rules: One dominant visual style per lesson; avoid random mixing.
Accent kanji (1–2) may use a different style for memory emphasis.
Do not reorder lessons or modify master kanji structure.
Primitive references are handled through hyperlinks, not visual reordering.
